name: agent-crash-recovery-inngest
description: The TypeScript half of the repo. There was no manifest until 2026-09-08, so every documented `npx tsx inngest_impl/...` command failed to resolve its imports. inngest is pinned at 4.20.0 because serve.ts imports inngest/node, and that adapter does not exist before 4.x: on 3.27.4 the server dies with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED.
